title: India’s textiles minister highlights green manufacturing at Welspun
content:
The Minister of Textiles Giriraj Singh has visited Welspun World’s Anjar complex in Kutch, observing production from spinning to towels and bedsheets. 
He noted its integrated value chain, modern technology and facilities aligned with global quality standards, the Ministry of Textiles said. 
Singh cited green manufacturing, water recycling and resource conservation as essential to Developed India.

title: India nears $90 bn in Oct exports, eyes $1 trn annual target: Goyal
content:
India’s exports hit nearly $90 billion in October 2026, keeping India on track for a $1 trillion export target, Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal said. 
It included about $50 billion in merchandise and $40 billion in services; exports up to October reached $570 billion. 
At IITF 2026, he urged manufacturers, exporters, artisans and startups to expand overseas with FTAs, quality and sustainability.

title: Bangladesh RMG workers block highway over death rumour
content:
Garment workers in Gazipur’s Kaliakair blocked the Dhaka-Tangail highway on November 14 after a rumour that a worker injured in an earlier police clash had died. 
Traffic halted on both sides before police, Border Guard Bangladesh and other law enforcers cleared the road. 
Gazipur Industrial Police-2 said wage increases were the main demand and workers from seven to eight factories joined.
